messages:
gina: FYI customer #8921 — invoice count ~600 tokens higher than their SDK estimate. They sent a repro; SDK says 124 tokens but invoice shows 724. Can someone help triage?

joel: Can you paste the exact curl + SDK estimate output? small sample is fine.

gina: Sure — curl we used: 
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/completions \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer <redacted>" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"rwd-13b","input":"Summarize: ...","max_tokens":256}'
```
SDK estimator output: 
`{"prompt_tokens":84, "completion_tokens":40, "estimate_total":124}`

sara: Quick question — any function/tool calls or sidecar modifiers? Server can inject system prefills or KV metadata which the SDK estimator doesn't simulate. Did you capture the request trace or headers (X-Req-Trace / X-Redwood-Injected)?

gina: Trace id is `trace-0a1b2c`. Minimal trace snippet I can paste: 
```
event: server_inject_prefill
payload: {"system":["<|system|>Assistant preface: internal helper..."], "kv":{"session_meta":"uid:8921"}}
```

joel: That matches the pattern — sidecar injected a system preface + KV metadata. Metering counts those tokens but the client estimator only tokenizes the visible prompt/completion. I also see header `X-Redwood-Injected: prefills=1;kv=1` in the gateway logs.

sara: Repro recipe for metering: 1) replay the request with `?replay_meta=true` to include server injections in the returned payload, 2) compare `metering.tokens.total` in the replay vs local SDK estimate, 3) inspect `prefix_injected` field in metering export. I'll open an internal ticket to track.

support-bot: Ticket created: SUP-8921 -> linked MET-431 (metering) — assigned to metering triage.

joel: Short-term workaround: enable `expose_server_injections: true` in the SDK config (server will include `server_injected_tokens` on responses). That lets customers reconcile immediately.

gina: Customer ok to try workaround. Any ETA for a permanent fix (server injects counted but SDK estimator should simulate them)?

sara: I'll draft an RFC and route to infra + metering. Expect triage next sprint. cc @metering-team :thumbsup:

gina: Thanks — I'll update the customer with the workaround and link to SUP-8921.
